name: target_date
doc: Target date (the day this snapshot's data covers) (cast from bronze string)
comment: Derived from the source file name, not a CSV column. One file = one row.

name: file_updated_at
doc: Raw file update timestamp, parsed from e.g. '2025/06/09 00:13 UPDATE'
comment: Used to pick the latest of same-day revisions alongside source_data.
